info.title: IoT Connectivity Management Platform API
info.description: Core API for managing IoT SIM lifecycles, billing, and real-time connectivity diagnostics. Designed for MNOs, MVNOs, and Enterprise customers.

tags.name: Resellers
tags.description: Reseller management. Path segment **`{resellerId}`** on `/resellers/{resellerId}` and nested routes is the RESELLER **`tenants.tenant_id`** (**FR-058**, same value as JWT `resellerId`); query/body field **`resellerId`** keeps that meaning on list/filter APIs. tags.name: NetworkProfiles
tags.description:
**APN** and **Roaming** profile management (snapshots, publish/deprecate).
**Out-of-profile (OOP)** rates use **Carrier Service `roamingProfileId`** only — **not** a field on **PricePlan**.
For **in-profile** (MCC,MNC) allowlists reused by **Price Plans**, see tag **CoveredNetworkProfiles**.

tags.name: CoveredNetworkProfiles
tags.description:
**CoveredNetworkProfile** — reusable **in-profile** (MCC,MNC) coverage snapshots (**DRAFT / PUBLISHED / DEPRECATED**), referenced by **all** **Price Plan** types via **`coveredNetworkProfileId`** (**ONE_TIME**, **SIM_DEPENDENT_BUNDLE**, **FIXED_BUNDLE**, **TIERED_PRICING**).
Distinct from **RoamingProfile**: **OOP** routing is **Package → Carrier Service → roamingProfileId** only.

Error.description:
Unified error envelope for API responses.
- `code` uses stable machine-readable values (for example: `BAD_REQUEST`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_STATUS`, `REFERENCES_BLOCKED`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`).

because catalog rows may store specific legal/company or country/territory display names.
